_comments: The Master Agreement version dated 2026-02-02 — the standard terms every Order Form and Payment
ONE ROW PER VERSION, EVER. A version is never edited in place: signed contracts reference it, so
superseding it means a NEW row with a new dated SourceURL, and this one stays. That is the whole
reason ContractTemplate exists as a table rather than a column on Contract.
SourceURL is NOT NULL by design (ERD): a template version nobody can open is a row claiming to be
the standard terms with no way to prove it. It is the DATED url, not a 'current' link that changes
VersionLabel is the date rather than a semver-ish number, because that is how the business refers
to it and how the URL is built.

fields.Description: Blue Cypress Master Services Agreement, 2026-02-02 edition. 16 sections, 71 numbered provisions. Captured from the dated published URL; each provision carries its verbatim text so a negotiated deviation can be read beside the standard clause.
